topics.headline: Both US CPI and Eurozone HICP likely to miss "both higher" condition
topics.summary: Eurozone HICP already decelerated to 2.8% in June's flash estimate (from 3.2%), and US CPI is now expected to cool to ~3.9% YoY (from 4.2%) as Strait of Hormuz de-escalation reverses energy prices—making a simultaneous acceleration in both measures unlikely despite still-elevated SPF forecasts.

topics.headline: HY spreads near cycle-tights but showing modest widening bias
topics.summary: At ~267-280bps, HY OAS sits in the tightest 5% of 25-year history with limited cushion, and recent AI-equity selloffs plus a more hawkish Fed have nudged spreads modestly wider; still, strategists note spreads can linger tight for long periods absent a genuine recession/inflation catalyst.

topics.headline: BTC ETFs slip back to outflows after brief 3-day inflow streak
topics.summary: After a record eight-week outflow streak broke with $202M inflows through July 8, Bitcoin ETFs posted back-to-back daily outflows ($84.9M, $95.3M) on July 8-9 while Ethereum ETFs kept drawing money, leaving the 7-day outlook hinged on the July 14 CPI print and July 28-29 FOMC meeting.

topics.headline: VIX near mid-range 17, but FOMC and tariff risks loom
topics.summary: VIX sits around 16.8-16.9, inside its calm 12-20 "MID" band, but the July 28-29 FOMC meeting falls within the 30-day window alongside unresolved Section 122 tariff litigation and elevated single-stock (VIXEQ) volatility, all of which could push VIX above its trailing 3-month average even as index-level risk currently looks historically muted.

topics.headline: Hyperscaler power deals keep accelerating; near-certain "yes" within 30 days
topics.summary: Microsoft/Chevron just signed the 2.67 GW Project Kilby gas campus, National Grid put $1.75B behind it, and Meta is closing Canadian and Crusoe capacity deals — continuing an almost weekly cadence of gigawatt-scale PPAs and generation agreements that makes another qualifying announcement highly likely.
